newsitem.title: USA: Goodyear Q4 shr loss $2.63 vs profit $0.96.
newsitem.headline: Goodyear Q4 shr loss $2.63 vs profit $0.96.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
First Call Mean Estimate for Q4 was $1.05 per share.
First Call Mean Estimate for Year was $4.35 per share.
NOTE: Full company name is Goodyear Tire & Ribber Co.

1996 Q4 includes one-time charges totaling $872.5 million ($572.2 million after tax or $3.68 per share) in the fourth quarter including a $755.6 million write-down of its All American Pipeline and other one-time costs associated with rationalization of worldwide operations.

During the fourth quarter, Goodyear adjusted the accounting value of its oil transportation segment with its economic value based on probable future cash flows, resulting in a charge of $755.6 million ($499.3 million after tax or $3.21 per share).
Fourth quarter income, before one-time charges, was $164 million or $1.05 per share, compared with net income of $146.4 million or 96 cents per share in the 1995 quarter.
1996 earnings for the year before one-time charges were $674.7 million or $4.35 per share compared with $611 million or $4.02 per share in 1995.

1996 year net includes charges of $148.5 million ($95.3 million after tax or 62 cents per share) related to rationalization of production, worldwide work force reductions and consolidation of operations to position the company to be more cost competitive.

The company also recorded 1996 year net gains totaling $32.1 million ($21.6 million after tax or 14 cents per share) related to the sale of business property in Asia, a portion of an investment in an Asian plantation and the loss on the anticipated sale of a U.S. manufacturing facility.
